facts.note: At dinner, on the temple bell striking nine, the master had everyone show watches. Ruedi's was exact; Félix 20 min behind; Girard 4 min behind; the doctor 2 min ahead. The 'as he does every year' habit and the master's corrections are extra colour, not added sheet content.
After dinner she worked beside the master in the atelier; when the temple struck ten the wall regulator agreed exactly with the bell.
He sent her downstairs when the regulator showed twenty past ten; the regulator was running and he was well.
In the kitchen she compared her watch with Rosa's clock, which was exactly fifteen minutes fast. The 'on purpose' remark restates the same fast-clock relation.
The piano began at twelve minutes to eleven and stopped at one minute past eleven, both by the kitchen clock. The transcript gives the same two readings on the same clock.
She went straight down to the kitchen and stayed with Rosa from arrival until after the temple struck eleven.
